title: Active Context Envelope
description: modeller-agents-local copy of the ActiveContextEnvelope shape, authored to mirror testudo-backend's DRAFT, non-final contracts/active-context-envelope.schema.json (marked a design fixture, not a final generated API schema, per testudo-backend/12-api-event-and-schema-catalog.md section 8). This is a context/permission snapshot contract -- distinct in purpose from route.py's pre-existing intent/execution_policy routing-instruction shape (see route.py module docstring and gap-analysis.md section 'WI-03 envelope-purpose mismatch' for the reconciliation). LIMITATION: if the parallel testudo-backend mission changes the real ActiveContextEnvelope shape before this schema is consumed, this file must be RE-VERSIONED (schema_version bump), not silently reinterpreted to match the new shape.
x-additional-properties-rationale: Unlike mission-identity.schema.json / checkpoint-receipt.schema.json (additionalProperties:true, pre-existing defensive/extensible internal records), this schema mirrors a real, named external producer contract (testudo-backend's ActiveContextEnvelope) -- so unexpected fields are a consumer-side contract-drift signal, not forward-compatible extension, and additionalProperties:false is deliberate here, matching WI-02's precedent on runtime-event/runtime-receipt. NOTE: the shared _validate_schema_value engine (contracts.py) does not currently enforce additionalProperties -- this posture documents the intended contract shape; it is not yet mechanically enforced (see contracts.py module comment and WI-02 handoff for this known limitation).
